interview.q2_description_nongoals_users: Non-goals chosen: not a Forge install mirror; not an upstream contribution pipeline. Explicitly NOT chosen as non-goals, and so recorded as in-scope or deferred: Java engine work, own authoring tooling. Users: me.

interview.q5_verify: Linter writing a report artifact: python tools/verify.py > verify-report.txt; evidence verify-report.txt; exempt **/*.md
interview.q6_references: forge-docs, forge-common, forge-card-corpus, forge-token-corpus, forge-upstream. Engine workspace deliberately excluded - it is a mutable build area, protected by a prose rule instead of the hook.

interview.q8_doc_map: planes+engine -> OWNERSHIP.md; engine -> docs/ENGINE.md; tools+custom -> docs/ARCHITECTURE.md; tools -> README.md
